dedupe_keys.name: idea image database for earthquake damage annotation

description: IDEA, the Image Database for Earthquake damage Annotation, is a dataset of images of real structures collected by EUCENTRE, the European Centre for Training and Research in Earthquake Engineering, during post-earthquake reconnaissance surveys and ordinary inspections. Structural engineers annotated the images against a refined ontology of structural elements and damage types covering different structural typologies, construction materials and damage mechanisms, with a broader damage classification of crack, spalling, corrosion or exposed rebar, leaching, debris, other damage or mechanism, and non-structural damage. Its aim is to support deep-learning methods for automated structural damage detection, and training and dissemination. Coverage: structures photographed in EUCENTRE surveys; the record does not list the events or countries. Access: two ZIP archives, damage (about 9.6 GB) and no damage (about 10.6 GB), on Zenodo as version 1.0.0 of 2025, described in a Data in Brief article. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0; free. Caveats: the no-derivatives, non-commercial licence limits redistribution of modified or relabelled versions. Simulation uses are training damage detectors for rapid post-earthquake building inspection and linking observed damage states to fragility models. Related records: the StEER reconnaissance record and the Venezuela 2026 earthquake damage records.
